gen-gf-autour-one-sora: Sora reads precise and geometric, with round letters that keep their openings generous. Sora works nicely at a modest size under Autour One, whose bold display letters carry the loud part.
gen-gf-autour-one-space-grotesk: Expressive from the first glance, Autour One lets a clear channel run into every round letter, while Space Grotesk follows in a plain sans of steady ribbon strokes. Loud up top, level below.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-clash-grotesk: Clash Grotesk takes the body, clean and approachable, with strokes that never swell or thin. Balsamiq Sans above it is the louder voice, its stencil-like weight and rounded curves doing the shouting.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-fs-alpino: Cozy and casual, Alpino is tall in the body and tightly spaced, so its ascenders look short. Balsamiq Sans, bold and stencil-weighted, gives the pair its loudest, most playful quality.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-fs-familjen-grotesk: Balsamiq Sans brings bold, rounded letters whose walls are as heavy as the straight strokes. And Familjen Grotesk follows with lively sans text, tall in the lowercase and open on one side of its bowls.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-fs-hind: Bold and expressive up front, thanks to Balsamiq Sans. Hind then settles in as a sans with lowercase nearly matching its capitals, so the heading's stencil-like weight gets a quieter, steadier partner beneath.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-fs-nunito: Balsamiq Sans presses its strokes like twine into a flat surface, with no tight pinched curves. Nunito brings the sans text, approachable and contemporary, with big round bowls and terminals that stop clear of the stem.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-fs-pilcrow-rounded: Pilcrow Rounded sets warm, tall lowercase with big counters and curves that refuse to close, against Balsamiq Sans's bold display weight. Paragraphs would feel snug and friendly.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-fs-quicksand: Bubbly and bold, Balsamiq Sans pairs its stencil-like weight with Quicksand, a plain sans whose tall lowercase bowls look like blown glass bulbs. Give Quicksand a little extra size.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-akatab: Balsamiq Sans bends its strokes like a paperclip, bold and expressive, over Akatab, a sans whose round letters look cupped rather than clenched. Give Akatab a bit more size.
